items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Sammy Price took me... I made a lot of those records with Georgia White

ctx.x: Sammy Price used to work for those people. Because see, that was my introduction to the record industry. Sammy Price took me... I made a lot of those records with Georgia White, a Blues singer... Remember Georgia White, the Blues singer from the South?

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Johnny Temple... I made quite a few of those things with Sam Price... [INTERVIEWEE] He'd bring them in, yeah. That was Mel Williams' right-hand man.
